answer: To resist sybil floods, each new agent posts a time-locked bond that only unlocks after a tide of successful, independently graded attestations across many epochs. Identity is not a single node but a vine of those sealed grades, each countersigned by established graders with no shared custody path. A public atlas then maps invitation graphs and co-grading clusters so nearly-identical behavior or a tight clique of new accounts is visible and slashable before the bond releases. Cheap replicas cannot fake that history or wait out the lock without real work.
